text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1.Indexing of cubic and non-cubic powder patterns.2.Estimation of precise
lattice parameter of cubic crystals3.Estimation of crystal size and r.m.s.
strain in mechanically alloyed nanostructured metals.4.Determination of
retained austenite in quenched steel.5.Advanced stereographic
projections.6.Estimation of residual stress in cold worked metals by XRD.7.TEM
sample preparation, observation and SAD pattern analysis.
